Gufran Kalim Ansari vs State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Secy. ... on 6 November, 2025

: 
G.A. 
 Court No. - 30
 Hon'Ble Rajiv Gupta, J. 
Hon'Ble Tej Pratap Tiwari, J.

1. Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned AGA for the State and perused the record.
2.

The instant writ petition has been filed by the petitioner for the following relief:
"(1) To issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus commanding the opposite party No. 3 to conduct fair and proper investigation in pursuance of first information report registered as Case Crime No. 0432 of 2024, under Sections 406,
420, 506 IPC registered at P. S. Tikait Nagar, District- Barabanki against the opposite party No.4.
(2) To issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus commanding the opposite party No. 3 to consider the relevant documents and the representation dated 12.12.2024 of the petitioner in Case Crime No. 0432 of 2024, under Sections 406,
420, 506 IPC registered at P. S. Tikait Nagar, District- Barabanki, which is annexed as Annexure-2 to this writ petition.
(3) To issue a writ, order or direction as is deemed fit and proper under the circumstances of the case.

(4) To allow the cost of the writ petition."
3. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is the first informant in the present case and though the FIR in the instant case has been registered on 10.10.2024, yet the police is not investigating the case in fair and impartial manner.

4. In view of the above, the petitioner may move an application before the S.P. Barabanki District Barabanki, highlighting his grievance and seeking fair and impartial investigation and if such an application is moved before the S.P. Barabanki District Barabanki, the S.P. Barabanki District Barabanki/respondent no. 2 shall ensure the fair, impartial and expeditious investigation in the present case.
5.
With the aforesaid order, the present petition stands disposed of.
